item.description:
Redraft what you just said. Press Control+Option+R with nothing selected and your last dictation is rewritten in Draft, right where it landed — the lead-in and the stutters gone, your meaning kept. It works in any text field, a terminal included, and Control+Option+Z puts your own words back. With text selected, Redraft works through the selection as before.

Fewer rewrites kept as-is. The check that judges whether a rewrite lost too much now measures against what you actually said, not your "so basically" and your repeats — so the sentence you meant comes back instead of the one you stumbled through.

Missed a release? 0.17.8 made the app dictate through your Mac's own microphone, added a Microphone row in Settings with a live level bar, and keeps your sayings as you said them. 0.17.7 added a Web Design pack. 0.17.6 gave Flow an hour, took Breathe and Flow out of beta, added Control+Option+Backspace to delete what you just said, and made Redraft work after a quiet spell. Every release, in order: github.com/richardgaston/dictation-releases/releases.
